title: DETR Family Model Conversion
summary: This module facilitates the conversion of various DETR-family models, including DETR, Deformable DETR, RT-DETR, MaskFormer, and Table Transformer, from their original frameworks to the Hugging Face Transformers format.

nodes.label: Convert Core DETR Models
nodes.title: Core DETR Model Converters
nodes.description: Handles the conversion of original DETR checkpoints to the Hugging Face format.

nodes.label: Convert Deformable DETR & D-FINE
nodes.title: Deformable DETR & D-FINE Converters
nodes.description: Manages the conversion of Deformable DETR, DAB-DETR, D-FINE, and DEIMv2 model checkpoints.

nodes.label: Convert RT-DETR Models
nodes.title: RT-DETR Model Converters
nodes.description: Provides utilities for converting RT-DETR and RT-DETR v2 models to the Hugging Face ecosystem.

nodes.label: Convert MaskFormer Models
nodes.title: MaskFormer Model Converters
nodes.description: Converts MaskFormer models, including ResNet and Swin backbones, to the Hugging Face format.

nodes.label: Convert Table Transformer Models
nodes.title: Table Transformer Model Converters
nodes.description: Dedicated converters for Table Transformer models, supporting versions with and without Timm backbones.

nodes.label: Other DETR-like Converters
nodes.title: Miscellaneous DETR Converters
nodes.description: Includes conversion scripts for other specialized DETR-like models such as LW-DETR and RF-DETR.

groups.label: DETR Family Conversion Tools
groups.title: DETR Family Conversion Tools
groups.description: A collection of tools for migrating various DETR-based models to the Hugging Face Transformers library.
